Public Engineering Log • x64 & Native ARM64

Version History & Release Notes

Follow every milestone of RaggieSoft Installer Studio as it evolves in public as original, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 software.

Download Latest v0.4.1 (x64) Download Latest v0.4.1 (ARM64) View Commits on GitHub
Latest Release • November 2026

v0.4.1 — Dark-Mode Push Buttons & Live OS Theme Hot-Swapping

  • Dark-Mode-Aware Accessible Push Buttons (AttachAccessiblePushButtonSubclass): Replaced stock ComCtl32 v6 light-mode white push buttons across SetupWizard.exe (< Back, Next >, Cancel), InstallerStudio.exe, msiprism.exe, and RaggieSoftHelp.exe with 100% public-API SetWindowSubclass + GDI+ vector buttons (Royal Cobalt primary CTA fills, Slate-Navy secondary fills, inline UAC shield icons via BCM_SETSHIELD, and SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST system-brush fallback) while keeping native UI Automation Button roles and Alt+Key mnemonics intact.
  • Live WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet) Palette Hot-Swapping: All four Win32 GUI binaries now listen for live Windows 11 Light ↔ Dark Mode and Contrast Theme broadcasts, flipping DWM frames, cards, buttons, checkboxes, ListView headers, dropdowns, and RichEdit typography in < 16ms without restarting.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.0 — Native C++20 Help System, Dark-Mode UI Subclasses & AI Blueprints

  • New RaggieSoftHelp.exe Native C++20 Help Viewer: Converted RaggieSoft's modular .rshm.json documentation viewer into a 100% static /MT Win32 C++20 binary (zero .NET and zero WebView2 dependencies!) featuring Contents, Index, full-text Search, in-process HTML5-to-RTF typography (Msftedit.dll), and single-instance Named Pipe F1 IPC.
  • Bundled raggiesoft.installer-studio Offline Help Module: Shipped 8 comprehensive offline HTML5 chapters wired directly to F1 across all 10 views of InstallerStudio.exe.
  • Global Win32 Dark Mode Checkbox & ListView Header Subclasses: Added AttachAccessibleCheckboxSubclass and AttachDarkAwareListViewSubclass in RswGlassRenderer.hpp so checkboxes and SysListView32 column headers maintain ≥ 15.8:1 WCAG AAA contrast across Dark, Light, and High Contrast modes.
  • Expanded From-Scratch AI Agent Blueprints: Upgraded instbuild.exe --emit-ai-spec (/llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /SKILL.md) with an AI Pre-Flight Checklist and complete enterprise .rsip blueprint.
  • Automated WIC Window Screenshot Exporter: Added --export-screenshots across GUI tools for reproducible visual QA.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.3.0 — Editions Parity, LZMS Compression, Pre-MSI Runtimes, .MSM & SelectionTree

  • IDE Editions (Community == Premier): Defined Community, Express, Professional, and Premier tiers with Community permanently maintaining 100% feature parity with Premier.
  • Windows LZMS Solid Compression: Integrated COMPRESS_ALGORITHM_LZMS (Cabinet.lib) to shrink embedded Product.msi and offline runtime payloads inside Setup.exe.
  • Unlimited Pre-MSI [Prerequisite.*] Runtime Broker: Added curated (.NET 8/9/10, WebView2, VC++) and custom runtime execution before msiexec via WinHTTP download, LZMS offline embed, or Redist\—capturing standardized and custom RebootExitCodes (3010, 1641, 23, ...) under one UAC prompt.
  • Native 64-Bit [MergeModule.*] (.MSM) Merger: Built a pure 64-bit SQL + Cabinet.lib FDI Merge Module consumer with zero 32-bit COM dependencies.
  • Authentic Windows Installer SelectionTree & Clean Status Formatting: Added 32-bit ARGB split-dropdown feature icons, live byte-cost cards, DisallowAbsent core locks, and MsiFormatRecordW formatting so status text never prints unexpanded [1] tokens.
Bugfix & Polish • November 2026

v0.2.1 — Real-World Setup Fixes, Dark Mode Checkboxes & UAC Elevation Broker

  • Dark Mode Checkbox Subclassing in SetupWizard.exe: Eliminated ComCtl32 v6 black-on-black checkbox labels on Dark Mode wizard pages.
  • Consistent Footer Navigation: Placed < &Back in the bottom-right footer bar alongside Next > and Cancel and streamlined the AeroWizard command header.
  • Windows Installer Engine & UAC Fixes: Added persistent Signature / AppSearch locator SQL tables (fixing MSI Error 2228), Type 35 STARTMENUFOLDER directory formatting, unshimmed OS build properties, and seamless asInvoker → --elevated-msi-worker UAC elevation.
Feature Milestone • November 2026

v0.2.0 — Destination Computer Tree, Component Rules & Dual Dialog Designers

  • Added the Destination Computer folder tree, Setup Design view enforcing Microsoft Component Rules (ICE18, ICE38, ICE64, ICE80), File Associations & Shell Verbs, guided Win32 AeroWizards, and the 370×270 MSI.DLL SQL Dialog Designer.
Initial Preview • November 2026

v0.1.0 — Zero-Dependency Win32 C++20 Toolchain Foundation

  • Initial x64 + ARM64 static /MT release of instbuild.exe, SetupWizard.exe, InstallerStudio.exe, msiprism.exe, and insttests.exe with deterministic SHA-1 UUIDv5 GUIDs, RtlGetVersion + IsWow64Process2 detection, .rsip/.rsis/.rsii lossless AST, --emit-ai-spec, and --emit-vpat.
